task_description: Redesign the Agent Harbor chat surface to a Kiro-style bottom-anchored composer with inline controls (model selector, routing mode, 'why this model?' info icon, attach/repository/web-search icons, error->warning-icon->modal); add a welcome-screen landing + nest Conversations under the Chat nav item; and build three REAL context features (attach/upload incl. images with a vision gate, repository context, pluggable web search with Tavily default + Settings-configurable + keychain-stored key). Additionally, per explicit user request, incorporate local network (LAN) model sharing (consume LAN peers' models + a share/serve toggle + discovery seam), which was never previously implemented. Deliver on ONE feature branch off main; do NOT push/tag/PR. Update the architecture spec. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: cannot build tauri-app or hit live network; web-search and LAN live behavior are user-only, everything else is CI/host-verifiable.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: node_modules absent and the cargo cache cannot resolve deps offline, so cargo build/test/clippy and frontend vitest/tsc/eslint/prettier are CI-ONLY (they run in GitHub CI after the orchestrator pushes); the tauri-app crate always builds only in CI. The one runnable offline gate, per-crate `cargo fmt --check`, PASSES for all touched crates (domain, providers, persistence, tauri-app, secrets, orchestrator-core, routing). Command-surface parity was verified by inspection: all 13 new commands (read_text_file, read_file_base64, list_repo_files, set_web_search_provider, get_web_search_config, clear_web_search_provider, run_web_search, add_network_peer, list_network_peers, remove_network_peer, set_model_sharing, get_model_sharing, discover_network_peers) have a #[tauri::command] fn + _inner + generate_handler! registration in lib.rs + an IPC wrapper in ipc/commands.ts + a camelCase TS view type in types/index.ts. A semantic behavioral review (2026-09-10-040153-review.md) returned APPROVED: test-mock discipline matches the known CI failure classes (routeInvoke covers all 13 commands, new store fields webSearchEnabled/attachments reset everywhere, plugin-dialog open() mocked, findBy*/waitFor after state changes, explicit aria-labels), and behavioral invariants hold (welcome gated on activeConversationId; Enter/Shift+Enter IME-safe; sendState/sendError role=alert; single shared pendingOverride; vision gate blocks non-vision images; web-search fallback is visible and still-sends; LAN peer off-host privacy exclusion from local_provider_ids is real; context is 128 KiB capped; run_turn/send_message semantics unchanged). Test quality: new tests exercise real code paths (wiremock proofs of the web-search adapter + LAN-peer enumeration, domain::file_context helper unit tests with RFC-4648 base64 vectors, tauri-app _inner tests over InMemorySecretStore + in-memory Db, and vitest component/behavior tests), not static-value assertions. Three non-blocking review notes recorded (loopback-peer locality comment, a stale ProviderModelPicker doc comment, deferred multimodal image bytes). NOT pushed/tagged/PR'd per instructions.
